40010489.author: पदार्थः
40010489.content: धर्मभृताम् among the upholders of righteousness, वरः foremost, रामः Rama, इति thus, ब्रुवाणम् spoke, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded hands, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, सम्परिष्वज्य having hugged, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40010489.author: Translation
40010489.content: On hearing Sugriva who stood with folded hands, Rama, the foremost among the upholders of righteousness, hugged him and said:

40010490.author: पदार्थः
40010490.content: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, सौम्य O gentle one, इन्द्रः Indra, वर्षम् यत् वर्षते when he rains, सहस्रांशुः god with a thousand rays, वा or else, आदित्यः Sun, नभः sky, वितिमिरम् bright, कुर्यात् make, चन्द्रमाः Moon, पृथिवीं on the earth, रश्मिभिः with his rays, निर्मलाम् cool, कुर्यात् does, त्वद्विधः a person like you, मित्राणाम् for friends, प्रतिकुर्यात् help in turn, तत् that, चित्रम् strange, न भविष्यति will not be.

40010490.author: Translation
40010490.content: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the  Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.

40010491.author: पदार्थः
40010491.content: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, सौम्य O gentle one, इन्द्रः Indra, वर्षम् यत् वर्षते when he rains, सहस्रांशुः god with a thousand rays, वा or else, आदित्यः Sun, नभः sky, वितिमिरम् bright, कुर्यात् make, चन्द्रमाः Moon, पृथिवीं on the earth, रश्मिभिः with his rays, निर्मलाम् cool, कुर्यात् does, त्वद्विधः a person like you, मित्राणाम् for friends, प्रतिकुर्यात् help in turn, तत् that, चित्रम् strange, न भविष्यति will not be.

40010491.author: Translation
40010491.content: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the  Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.

40010492.author: पदार्थः
40010492.content: सौम्य gentle one, सुग्रीव Sugriva, एवम् that way, त्वयि you, शोभनम् well done, तत् that, चित्रम् surprising, न भवेत् will not be, त्वाम् you, सततम् always, प्रियवादिनम्  pleasing in talk, अहम् I, जानामि know.

40010492.author: Translation
40010492.content: 'O gentle Sugriva this your help to me is not surprising. You always help your friends and speak in a pleasing manner.

40010493.author: पदार्थः
40010493.content: सखे O friend, त्वत्सनाथः one supported by you, सङ्ख्ये in war, सकलान् all, अरीन् enemies, जेताऽस्मि I will win over, सुहृत् goodhearted, मित्रम् friend, त्वमेव you alone, मे to me, साहाय्यम् help, कर्तुम् to render, अर्हसि it is proper on your part.

40010493.author: Translation
40010493.content: 'O friend I will win over all enemies in war supported by you.You are a goodhearted friend and you alone should help me.

40010494.author: पदार्थः
40010494.content: राक्षसाधमः lowly demon, वञ्चयित्वा after deceiving, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अनुह्लादः Anuhlada, पौलोमीम् Poulomi ( Indra's wife), शचीं यथा like Sachi, आत्मविनाशाय for his own destruction, जहार took away.

40010494.author: Translation
40010494.content: Just as Anuhlada (son of Hiranyakasipu and brother of Prahlada) took away, Poulomi  (Sachi, daughter of Puloma) deceiving Indra, this lowly demon took away Sita, daughter of the king of Videha.

40010495.author: पदार्थः
40010495.content: तं रावणम् that Ravana, न चिरात् very soon, अहवे in a battle, शतक्रतुः one who has done a hundred sacrifices, Indra, पौलोम्याः Pouloma's, दृप्तम् proud, पितरम् father, निशितैः with sharp ones, शरैः arrows, हनिष्यामि will kill.

40010495.author: Translation
40010495.content: 'I will kill Ravana with my sharp arrows just as Indra, (who had done a hundred sacrifices) killed the proud father of Poulomi.

40010496.author: पदार्थः
40010496.content: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the mean while, गगने in the sky, सहस्रांशोः thousandrayed Sun's, उष्णां तीव्राम् intense heat, प्रभाम् radiance, छादयत् covering, रजः dust, समभिवर्तत was raised.

40010496.author: Translation
40010496.content: In the mean while the dust raised (by army of monkeys) all over obscured the intense heat from the sky and the radiance of the thousandrayed Sun.

40010497.author: पदार्थः
40010497.content: तेन by that, रजसा by the dust, मूर्छता by the spread, दिशः sides, पर्याकुलाश्च became mixed up,  सशैलवनकानना including mountains, gardens and forests, सर्वा all, मही च and earth, चचाल was shaken.

40010497.author: Translation
40010497.content: By the spreading of dust, the quarters were not visible.The earth including the mountains gardens and forests was shaken up.

40010498.author: पदार्थः
40010498.content: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

40010498.author: Translation
40010498.content: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.

40010499.author: पदार्थः
40010499.content: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

40010499.content: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.

40010500.content: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

40010501.author: पदार्थः
40010501.content: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

40010502.author: पदार्थः
40010502.content: तदा then, दशभिः by ten, कोटीसहस्रैः thousand crores, परिवृतः accompanied by, श्रीमान् glorious, वीरः warrior, शतवलिर्नाम named Satavali, वानरः monkey, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared on the site.

40010502.author: Translation
40010502.content: Then appeared the glorious warrior named Satavali, followed by ten thousand crore of monkeys.

40010503.author: पदार्थः
40010503.content: ततः then, काञ्चनशैलाभः appearing like the golden mountain (Meru), वीर्यवान् valiant, पिता father, दशसाहस्रैः by ten thousand, कोटिभिः by crores, अनेकैः and many, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared with, ताराया Tara's.

40010503.author: Translation
40010503.content: (Next came) the valiant father of Tara of golden complexion like mount Meru followed by ten thousand crore of vanaras.

40010504.author: पदार्थः
40010504.content: तथा likewise, विभुः mighty one, रुमायाः पिता father of Ruma, सुग्रीवश्वशुरः king Sugriva's fatherinlaw, अपरेण by another, कोटीनाम् by a crore, सहस्रेण thousand, समन्वितः accompanied with, सम्प्राप्तः reached.

40010504.author: Translation
40010504.content: Likewise mighty father of Ruma, fatherinlaw of Sugriva, reached there accompanied by a thousand crore monkeys.

40010505.author: पदार्थः
40010505.content: पद्मकेसरसङ्काशः like lotus filaments in colour, तरुणार्कनिभाननः with the countenance red like the early morning Sun, बुद्धिमान् wise, वानरश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, सर्ववानरसत्तमः the best among vanaras, हनुमतः Hanuman's, पिता father, श्रीमान् prosperous, केसरी Kesari, वानराणाम् of vanaras, अनेकैः many, बहुसाहस्रैः by many thousands, समन्वितः accompanied by, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

40010505.author: Translation
40010505.content: Then arrived Kesari, the wise and illustrious monkey, foremost and the best among vanaras, father of Hanuman. He was of the colour of lotus filaments and his countenance was red like the early morning Sun. He was accompanied by many thousands of monkeys.

40010506.author: पदार्थः
40010506.content: पद्मकेसरसङ्काशः like lotus filaments in colour, तरुणार्कनिभाननः with the countenance red like the early morning Sun, बुद्धिमान् wise, वानरश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, सर्ववानरसत्तमः the best among vanaras, हनुमतः Hanuman's, पिता father, श्रीमान् prosperous, केसरी Kesari, वानराणाम् of vanaras, अनेकैः many, बहुसाहस्रैः by many thousands, समन्वितः accompanied by, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

40010506.author: Translation
40010506.content: Then arrived Kesari, the wise and illustrious monkey, foremost and the best among vanaras, father of Hanuman. He was of the colour of lotus filaments and his countenance was red like the early morning Sun. He was accompanied by many thousands of monkeys.

40010507.author: पदार्थः
40010507.content: वानराणाम् of vanaras, कोटिसहस्रेण by a thousand crores, वृतः surrounded, गोलाङ्गूलमहाराजः king of Langur, भीमविक्रमः a warrior of fierce valour, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, अदृश्यत was seen

40010507.author: Translation
40010507.content: Next arrived Gavaksha, king of Langurs (whose tail resembled the cow's), of fierceful courage surrounded by a thousand crore of vanaras.

40010508.author: पदार्थः
40010508.content: शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of enemies, धूम्रः Dhumra, भीमवेगानाम् of those of frightening speed, ऋक्षाणाम् of bears, द्वाभ्याम् with two, कोटिसहस्राभ्याम् thousand crores, समभिवर्तत arrived there.

40010508.author: Translation
40010508.content: Dhumra, destroyer of enemies, came next followed by two thousand crore of bears of terrible speed.

40010509.author: पदार्थः
40010509.content: पनसो नाम Panasa by name, महावीर्यः a great warrior, यूथपः troop leader, तिसृभिः कोटिभिः by three crores, महाचलनिभैः by those resembling huge mountains, घोरैः by a dreadful one, वृतः surrounded by, आजगाम came.

40010509.author: Translation
40010509.content: Similarly, the great warrior named Panasa, leader of the troop, reported with three crore dreadful vanaras of the size of huge mountains.

40010510.author: पदार्थः
40010510.content: अथ then, दशभिः कोटिभिः by ten crore, वृतः surrounded, नीलाञ्जनचयाकारः dark like a mountain of collyrium, महाकायः of huge body, नीलो नाम by name Nila, यूथपः leader, अदृश्यत appeared.

40010510.author: Translation
40010510.content: Then appeared Nila of huge body, dark like a mountain of collyrium accompanied by ten crore vanaras.

40010511.author: पदार्थः
40010511.content: ततः then, काञ्चनशैलाभः appearing like golden mountain, महावीर्यः a great warrior, गवयो नाम Gavaya by name, यूथपः leader of a group, पञ्चभिः कोटिभिः by five crores, वृतः surrounded, आजगाम arrived.

40010511.author: Translation
40010511.content: Then arrived the leader of five crore vanaras, the great warrior Gavaya who resembled a golden mountain.

40010512.author: पदार्थः
40010512.content: तदा then, बलवान् strong, दरीमुखः Darimukha, यूथपः leader, कोटिसहस्रेण with one thousand crores, वृतः surrounded, अभ्याययौ came near, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, समुपस्थितः approached.

40010512.author: Translation
40010512.content: Then the strong Darimukha, leader of a thousand crore monkeys approached Sugriva.

40010513.author: पदार्थः
40010513.content: महाबलौ two very powerful, अश्विपुत्रौ two sons of Asvi, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च Dvivida, उभौ both, वानराणाम् vanaras, कोटिकोटिसहस्रेण by a thousand crores, अदृश्यताम् appeared.

40010513.author: Translation
40010513.content: Two very powerful sons of Asvini, Mainda and Dvivida, appeared with a thousand crore vanaras.

40010514.author: पदार्थः
40010514.content: बलवान् stout, वीरः hero, महातेजाः mighty, गजश्च Gaja also, तिसृभिः कोटिभिः with three crores of vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, सुग्रीवस्य of Sugriva, समीपतः presence, आजगाम reached.

40010514.author: Translation
40010514.content: Strong and powerful Gaja also reached Sugriva with three crore vanaras.

40010515.author: पदार्थः
40010515.content: महातेजाः glorious, नामतः by name, जाम्बवान् नाम called Jambavan, ऋक्षराजः king of bears, दशभिः ten, कोटिभि with crores, प्राप्तः got, सुग्रीवस्य to Sugriva, वशे under control, स्थितः stood.

40010515.author: Translation
40010515.content: Glorious Jambavan, king of bears, stood before Sugriva with ten thousand crore vanaras.

40010516.author: पदार्थः
40010516.content: विक्रान्तः victorious, वानरैः with vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, बलवान् sturdy, रुमण्वन्नाम  called Rumanvan, कोटीशतसमावृतः surrounded by hundred crores of vanaras, तूर्णम् swiftly, समावृतः came and assembled.

40010516.author: Translation
40010516.content: Sturdy and victorious vanara called Rumanvan came swiftly followed by a hundred crore vanaras.

40010517.author: पदार्थः
40010517.content: ततः then, कोटिसहस्राणाम् of a thousand crore, सहस्रेण by a thousand, शतेन च by a hundred also, वानरैः with vanara, पृष्ठतः behind him, अनुगतः followed, गन्धमादन: Gandhamadana, प्राप्तः came.

40010517.author: Translation
40010517.content: Then came Gandhamadana with a hundred thousand crore of vanaras following him.

40010518.author: पदार्थः
40010518.content: ततः then, पितुः तुल्यपराक्रमः comparable in prowess to his father, युवराजः heir apparent, अङ्गदः Angada, पद्मसहस्रेण with a thousand Padmas (trillion), शङ्कुशतेन च one hundred times Sanku (ten trillion), वृतः surrounded, प्राप्तः arrived.

40010518.author: Translation
40010518.content: Then arrived the heir apparent, Angada, whose prowess is comparable to that of his father with him came a thousand padmas and a hundred sankus of followers.

40010519.author: पदार्थः
40010519.content: ततः then, ताराद्युतिः shining like a star, भीमपराक्रमः a warrior of terrific valour, तारः Tara, हरिः vanara, पञ्चभिः with five, हरिकोटीभिः with crores of vanaras, दूरतः at a distance, प्रत्यदृश्यत was seen.

40010519.author: Translation
40010519.content: And Tara (brother of Ruma's father) of terrific valour shining like a star showed up at a distance with five crore vanaras.

40010520.author: पदार्थः
40010520.content: एकादशानां कोटीनाम् of eleven crores of vanaras, ईश्वरः chief, वीरःhero, यूथपः leader of troop, इन्द्रजानुः Indrajanu, कपिः vanara, तैः with them, समावृतः surrounded, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

40010520.author: Translation
40010520.content: Then Indrajanu the troop leader and chief of vanaras appeared along with eleven crore monkeys.

40010521.author: पदार्थः
40010521.content: ततः thereafter, तरुणादित्यसन्निभः of the colour of the rising Sun, रम्भः Rambha, अयुतेना by one ayuta (10,000), सहस्रेण by a thousand, शतेन च by a hundred, वृतः surrounded, अनुप्राप्तः arrived

40010521.author: Translation
40010521.content: Thereafter Rambha of the colour of the rising Sun brought together an army of one thousand and one hundred ayuta troops.

40010522.author: पदार्थः
40010522.content: ततः thereafter, यूथपतिः leader of the troop, वीरः hero, बली strong one, दुर्मुखो नाम Durmukha by name, वानरः vanara, द्वाभ्याम् with two, कोटीभ्याम् with crores, परिवृतः surrounded, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

40010522.author: Translation
40010522.content: Thereafter the mighty hero, leader of the troop, by name Durmukha appeared with  two crore vanaras.

40010523.author: पदार्थः
40010523.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, कैलासशिखराकारैः with those like the peaks of Kailasa mountain, भीमविक्रमैः with warriors of frightful valour, कोटिसहस्रेण by one thousand crores, वानरैः with vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, प्रत्यदृश्यत showed up.

40010523.author: Translation
40010523.content: And Hanuman showed up surrounded by a thousand crore vanaras of frightful valour. They looked like the peaks of Kailasa mountain.

40010524.author: पदार्थः
40010524.content: महावीर्यः valiant, नलश्चापि Nala also, कोटीशतेन by a hundred crores, सहस्रेण by a thousand, शतेन च and by hundreds, द्रुमवासिभिः by the tree dwellers(monkeys), संवृतः surrounded by, सम्प्राप्तः arrived.

40010524.author: Translation
40010524.content: Valiant Nala also arrived surrounded by a hundred crore and a hundred thousand treedwellers (monkeys).

40010525.author: पदार्थः
40010525.content: ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, दशभिः with ten, कोटिभिः with crore, वृतः surrounded with, अभिमतः a favourite one, तस्य his, महात्मनः सुग्रीस्य of great Sugriva, सम्प्राप्तः reached.

40010525.author: Translation
40010525.content: Then the illustrious Dadhimukha, great Sugriva's favourite leader reached with ten crore vanaras.

40010526.author: पदार्थः
40010526.content: शरभः Sarabha, कुमुदः Kumuda, वानरः vanara, वह्निः Vahni, रंहः एव च and so also Ramha, एते all of them, कामरूपिणः who can assume any form at will, अन्ये च and others, बहवः many, तेषाम् of them, संख्या number, वानराः vanaras, यूथपाः troops, सर्वाम् entire, पृथिवीम् land, पर्वतांश्च and mountains, वनानि च and forests also, आवृत्य having occupied, समनुप्राप्ताः advancing towards, आगताः came, सर्ववानराः all the vanaras, पृथिव्याम् of the earth, विशिष्टाश्च outstanding.

40010526.author: Translation
40010526.content: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.

40010527.author: पदार्थः
40010527.content: शरभः Sarabha, कुमुदः Kumuda, वानरः vanara, वह्निः Vahni, रंहः एव च and so also Ramha, एते all of them, कामरूपिणः who can assume any form at will, अन्ये च and others, बहवः many, तेषाम् of them, संख्या number, वानराः vanaras, यूथपाः troops, सर्वाम् entire, पृथिवीम् land, पर्वतांश्च and mountains, वनानि च and forests also, आवृत्य having occupied, समनुप्राप्ताः advancing towards, आगताः came, सर्ववानराः all the vanaras, पृथिव्याम् of the earth, विशिष्टाश्च outstanding.

40010527.author: Translation
40010527.content: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.

40010528.author: पदार्थः
40010528.content: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, आप्लवन्तः leaping in enthusiasm, प्लवन्तश्च and jumping, गर्जन्तश्च and roaring, सूर्यम् Sun, अभ्रगणा इव like the clouds, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभ्यवर्तन्त approached.

40010528.author: Translation
40010528.content: The monkeys came leaping, jumping and roaring in enthusiasm and surrounded Sugriva just as clouds surround the Sun.

40010529.author: पदार्थः
40010529.content: प्रहृष्टाः happy ones, बाहुशालिनः of sturdy shoulders, बहुशब्दान् many kinds of noises, कुर्वाणाः while they made, शिरोभिः with their heads, वानरेन्द्राय to the lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, न्यवेदयन् reported.

40010529.author: Translation
40010529.content: The leaders of monkeys possesing sturdy shoulders made many kinds of noises and reported to Sugriva, bending their heads in reverence.

40010530.author: पदार्थः
40010530.content: अपरे others, वानरश्रेष्ठाः foremost of vanaras, यथोचितम् in a suitable manner, सङ्गम्य after coming together, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समागम्य after reaching, तदा then, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands in salutation, स्थिताः stood.

40010530.author: Translation
40010530.content: Thereafter the vanaras came close to Sugriva freely and on reaching him stood, offering salutations with folded hands.

40010531.author: पदार्थः
40010531.content: धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, त्वरितः at once, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, स्थितः stood, वानरर्षभान् prominent vanaras, तान् them, सर्वान् all, रामे to Rama, निवेदयित्वा having presented, अब्रवीत् said.

40010531.author: Translation
40010531.content: Sugriva, knower of dharma, at once presented all the prominent vanaras to Rama, and standing with folded hands said.

40010532.author: पदार्थः
40010532.content: वानरेन्द्राः best of vanaras, पर्वतनिझरेषु by the side of swift mountain streams, सर्वेषु in all, वनेषु च in forests, यथासुखम् comfortably settled, विधिवत् as per tradition, बलानि army, निवेशयित्वा after lodging, बलज्ञः know the strength, बलम् of army, प्रतिपत्तुम् to know, ईष्टे decided.

40010532.author: Translation
40010532.content: Sugriva told the chiefs to station the forces by the side  of swift mountain streams, in forests, and hills and ascertain their exact number. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
